title: Initial write-sweep family
statement: Let $Ninmathbb{N}$, let $E$ inject the symbols of an alphabet $Gamma$ together with blank into blocks of $N+1$ optional bits, let $t:bb{Z}tomathrm{Option}Gamma$ be a tape, and let $pinbb{Z}$ and $winmathrm{Option}Gamma$. At counter $0$, the write-sweep block family is the blockwise coding of the tape that agrees with $t$ except that its value at $p$ is $w$.
replaced:
At counter $0$ (after the write is complete) the partially rewritten block family for
tape $t$, write position $p$, and new symbol $w$ is the blockwise coding of the updated
tape that agrees with $t$ everywhere except that position $p$ now holds $w$.
